commit ca7c85bec3e7
Author: zdk <di.warachet@gmail.com>
Date:   Fri Apr 10 20:55:44 2026 +0700

    add plugin scaffolding, shell/ruby/lua runtimes, remove lowfat-community
    
    - Add `lowfat plugin new` command to scaffold plugins with generated
      filter code for shell, node, python, deno, ruby, and lua runtimes
    - Add shell, ruby, lua as first-class runtime types
    - Remove lowfat-community crate (community filters are now plugins)
    - Add integration tests for all runtimes (shell, node, python, ruby, lua)
    - Update README with plugin authoring workflow
